notes: Counted each full two-agent onion-to-pot cycle (agent1 supplies onions to counter, agent0 picks them and loads pot) plus each dish handoff cycle (agent1 brings plate to counter, agent0 picks plated soup and serves) as constructive interdependences. These clearly enable later reward-yielding deliveries. No obvious redundant passing back-and-forth or off-goal interactions, so non_constructive, looping, and irrelevant set to 0. Episode is highly regular and symmetric; 40 is an approximate but conservative aggregation over many repeated identical patterns.
